articles.title: Dairy body, Assam Rifles sign supply pact to support farmers in north-east
articles.summary: The National Cooperative Dairy Federation (NCDFI) and Assam Rifles have signed an agreement to significantly expand the supply of milk and dairy products to military units across the north-east region. This strategic partnership aims to enhance troop welfare by ensuring improved quality provisions and robust logistics, vital for personnel operating in challenging terrains. It also strengthens civil-military cooperation and supports the cooperative sector.

articles.title: Show HN: Claude Code plugin for deep multi-agent code reviews
articles.summary: A sophisticated Claude Code plugin has been developed to perform senior-engineer-grade code reviews for software repositories. The plugin generates detailed findings in a 'findings.md' file, highlighting a significant advancement in AI-driven automation for quality assurance in software development.

articles.title: Trump Administration Accelerates US-China Critical Minerals Decoupling as Pentagon’s 2027 Defense Deadline Reshapes a $30 Billion Magnet Market
